hypotheses.justification: Compactness is never used. hT_compact appears only as an argument to `abs_eigenvector_of_top_eigenvector`, and that lemma names it `_hT_compact` and never uses it. Its proof uses only self-adjointness, positivity preservation, the eigen-equation, the upper bound `hlam₀_top`, and `eq_smul_self_of_isLocalExtrOn`, which needs only `IsSelfAdjoint T`. The rest of `eigenvector_constant_sign` uses `ground_state_strictly_positive`, which has no compactness hypothesis. So the theorem is true and provable without `hT_compact`. To remove it, drop the unused `_hT_compact` binder from `abs_eigenvector_of_top_eigenvector`, or copy its proof inline, and delete the argument at the call site. No degenerate cases arise.
